Elements hidden via inline style="display:none" must not appear in the output

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result)
}
```
